in_marathi.name: Nandram
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nandram हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit words ‘nand’ meaning joy and ‘ram’ meaning giver or protector. In Hindu mythology, Lord Rama is a revered deity known for his unwavering commitment to duty, love, and sacrifice. Nandram embodies the spirit of selflessness and joy in giving.
